title: Email & notifications
description: Configure the marketing sender identity and footer. Recipients manage their own preferences.
previewNote: No email will be sent. These links belong only to the current Root account. Do not forward them.
preferenceDescription: Choose what you want to receive. Signing up, paying or joining a team does not subscribe you to marketing.
serviceNotice: These settings do not cancel your plan. Necessary account, security and billing notices will continue.
unsubscribeDescription: This will stop all marketing categories for this address. No login or reason is required.
unsubscribed: You have unsubscribed from all marketing
invalidLink: This link is invalid or expired. Sign in to manage your email preferences.
controlsBody: Marketing categories are off by default and require the recipient to opt in. Administrators cannot subscribe other users. Plan changes, expiry and usage notices use separate service notification flows.
scopeNote: Campaigns and welcome steps send only after explicit activation or queue confirmation. Plan, usage and expiry notices use separate service flows.
noR: Recipients use self-service links. No email reply is required.
error: The request failed. Please try again.
emptyIdentity: Save the actual sender identity before generating a preview.
consent: Saving confirms your choices. You can change them or unsubscribe at any time using the links in our emails.
campaignDescription: Feature news, app releases and announcements follow product-update consent. Every recipient gets an individual message.
subject: Email subject
excluded: Excluded by consent, suppression or caps
queueWarning: Only currently consenting, eligible recipients are included. You can cancel messages that have not started sending.
noCampaigns: No campaigns yet. Save a draft, preview it, then confirm queueing.
senderMissing: SMTP is not configured. Drafts can be saved but sending cannot start.
workerManual: Background sending is disabled in this runtime. Process the queue manually or through an authorized scheduler call.
campaignLimits: At most one marketing email per 7 days and three per 30 days. Monthly digests are capped at one per UTC calendar month. Up to 10,000 recipients per campaign.
saveBeforePreview: Save your edits, then preview the audience again.
onboardingDescription: Only accounts created after each step is enabled are enrolled. Password and OAuth signup are supported. Each step is queued once per account.
helloNotice: Hello is a one-time account-service guide. Do not include promotions or upgrade sales. Enabling enrolls future new accounts.
tutorialNotice: Follow-up tutorials require explicit tutorial consent. Step order and recipient frequency are checked before sending; capped steps are deferred. Disabling a step stops its unsent messages.
templateVariables: Supports {{name}}. Content is safely rendered as plain text. All action URLs must use HTTPS.
ackUnknown: I checked SMTP records and understand that retrying may send a duplicate
unknownNotice: Unknown SMTP outcomes are never retried automatically. Check the provider record before requeueing.
suppressionDescription: Record provider-confirmed bounces or complaints. Addresses on this list are skipped for marketing and welcome messages.

templates.subject: Hello {{name}}, welcome to XWorkmate
templates.body:
Hello {{name}},

Your account is ready. Start in account settings to review your email, security options and current plan.

Then connect a device or configure your workspace when ready. Contact support if you need help.

templates.subject: Get started: make your first connection
templates.body:
Hello {{name}},

1. Open the regional entry pool.
2. Choose an entry available to your account.
3. Connect in the app, then review your status in account settings.

templates.subject: Next: configure your workspace
templates.body:
Hello {{name}},

After the basic setup, visit integrations to connect the services you use. Add only the integrations you need, and enter credentials through the secure controls provided.
